title: Index ticker + indicator
description: The index ticker is the signal; the traded instrument is configured separately and resolved before anything is proposed.

index_symbol.description: Index ticker whose candles drive the signal (for example 'NIFTY 50'). This is never traded.

interval.description: Candle interval for the index series.

lookback.description: How many recent index candles to read.

indicator.description: One of the platform's allowlisted indicators, computed server-side.

traded_symbol.description: The instrument actually traded (for example 'RELIANCE'). Required before any proposal is built.

product.description: Frozen product for the traded instrument.

quantity.description: Signed target quantity to hold when the signal is bullish.

deadline_seconds.description: How long the child waits for an owner decision on an approval-based request.
